## Walkthrough This change updates the kube-controller-manager component's ownership configuration by replacing individual reviewer/approver entries with a group alias. A new OWNERS_ALIASES file defines the `control-plane-approvers` group membership. ## Changes |Cohort / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Ownership Configuration**
`OWNERS`|Replaced individual reviewers (`atiratree`, `deads2k`, `ingvagabund`) with the `control-plane-approvers` group alias for the kube-controller-manager component in both reviewers and approvers fields.| |**Ownership Aliases**
`OWNERS_ALIASES`|Added new `control-plane-approvers` alias group mapping to a fixed set of GitHub user identifiers including `ardaguclu`, `atiratree`, `benluddy`, and others for centralized ownership management.| ## Estimated code review effort 🎯 1 (Trivial) | ⏱️ ~3 minutes
